name: k8s API server — the readiness probe or any named readiness check fails for 3 consecutive minutes
description: Fires, per readiness check, when MAX(livespec.ci_k3s.readiness_check) over the trailing 3 min is below 1: the check reported 0 on every once-a-minute probe. The check named api-server is the probe itself (kubectl could not read /readyz?verbose); every other name is a line of /readyz?verbose. Complements, and does not replace, ci-k3s-api-unavailable, which fires on a k3s restart seen by the lifecycle sweep. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-k3s-control-plane-telemetry.sh (1-min timer, livespec-dev-tooling-vdleg7). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; ssh poweredge-xubuntu; kubectl get --raw='/readyz?verbose'; journalctl -u k3s --since -30min; df -h /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/db. Silence is the control-plane dead-man's job. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
